description: NaLaSe₂ is Caswellsilverite structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent Se²⁻ atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent LaSe₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent LaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 2°. All Na-Se bond lengths are 3.09 Å. La³⁺ is bonded to six equivalent Se²⁻ atoms to form LaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent LaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 2°. All La-Se bond lengths are 3.02 Å. Se²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent La³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₃La₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
